nodes.summary: The Boolean gates are a NOT gate and, for each natural number $a$, an AND gate and an OR gate indexed by $a$, which stand for gates with $a + 1$ inputs. The numbers of inputs are assigned by the Boolean signature, so there is no AND or OR gate with zero inputs.
nodes.title: Boolean gates

nodes.summary: For every natural number $a$ and truth values $x_0, \dots, x_a$, the Boolean interpretation of the AND gate with $a + 1$ inputs, applied to $x_0, \dots, x_a$, returns $(\cdots((\mathrm{true} \land x_0) \land x_1) \cdots) \land x_a$, folding conjunction over the inputs from left to right starting from true.
nodes.title: Boolean AND as a left fold

nodes.summary: Under the Boolean interpretation, the NOT gate applied to a truth value $x$ returns its negation $\lnot x$.
nodes.title: Boolean NOT

nodes.summary: For every natural number $a$ and truth values $x_0, \dots, x_a$, the Boolean interpretation of the OR gate with $a + 1$ inputs, applied to $x_0, \dots, x_a$, returns $(\cdots((\mathrm{false} \lor x_0) \lor x_1) \cdots) \lor x_a$, folding disjunction over the inputs from left to right starting from false.
nodes.title: Boolean OR as a left fold

nodes.summary: The Boolean interpretation evaluates the gates of the Boolean signature on the truth values $\{\mathrm{false}, \mathrm{true}\}$: NOT sends its input $x$ to $\lnot x$, and for each natural number $a$, the AND gate and the OR gate with inputs $x_0, \dots, x_a$ return $(\cdots((\mathrm{true} \land x_0) \land x_1) \cdots) \land x_a$ and $(\cdots((\mathrm{false} \lor x_0) \lor x_1) \cdots) \lor x_a$ respectively, that…
nodes.title: Boolean interpretation

nodes.summary: The Boolean signature has the Boolean gates as its operation symbols, where NOT has arity $1$ and, for each natural number $a$, the AND gate and the OR gate indexed by $a$ have arity $a + 1$. In particular, no AND or OR gate takes zero inputs.
nodes.title: Boolean signature

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
